name: provared-shopify
description: A small MCP server for one Shopify store's Admin API (products, a variant's price, discount codes, orders, refunds), made to be started by provared-mcp-executor, which checks each tool call against a permission a person signed with a passkey and writes a signed receipt. Money and percentages are whole numbers at fixed places, so that a permission can limit them. Tried only against a made-up server.
author: Pavel Izmaylov
